title: Global phase and relative phase
objectives: Distinguish coordinate equality, global-phase equivalence and equal Z statistics.
Demonstrate relative phase through X-basis overlaps.
prerequisites: Chapter 3’s complex amplitudes, normalization, inner products and projectors; Chapter 2’s probability and count distinction.

quizzes.question: Which state differs from |+⟩ only by a global phase?
feedback: Correct: the whole vector is multiplied by −1.

quizzes.question: For (|0>+exp(i phi)|1>)/sqrt(2), which statement holds?
options: X-positive probability can change while Z probabilities stay fixed.
Changing phi is always a global phase.
feedback: Z probabilities are 1/2 for all phi.
Changing one component phase can change relative phase.
